title: Appointed as Assistant
original: Coming, coming! Warmy coming in with warmth! Huh...? Sheesh, Doctor! No calling me a little potlid like Lanns!

title: Talk 1
original: Doctor, do you smell that? Hehe, it's the smell of my sweet pear and vegetables soup, slow cooked to perfection! I said it before, I'm gonna cook the best meals to cure everyone's Oripathy! Huff, huff—It's not so hot anymore. Give it a try, won'tcha? If you don't, everyone else will eat it right up!

title: Talk 2
original: Rhodes Island is such a big, biiiig transport, and it has a kinda different furnace than the one at the factory... Oh, I just went to the engine level. The boiler man there thought I was lost and took me back up. I was fine down there, though. I'm used to the heat.

title: Talk 3
original: Come, Doctor. Hurry up and eat. No need to worry about me. It cheers me right up to see people enjoying their food. Aw, you still want to share with me? Okay, I'll clean this plate! Om nom nom... Wha? You were just picking out things you don't want to eat? Well alright then.

title: Talk after Promotion 1
original: I made this bracelet from bottle tree leaves. I can keep them fresh for a short while. Hehe, didn't think my Arts could be used like this, did you? Oh, Don't worry, it'll only be for a short while. I won't keep it going for too long, or they'll get tired, too. We should let them be. The withering will come slowly.

title: Talk after Promotion 2
original: Dad liked to collect the carrots we had left to carve into small animals. Doctor, do you think Ray will like this carrot sandbeast? Ah! I think I carved a little too deep. I'm still not very good at this, not like Dad. If only he'd taught me a bit longer...

title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
original: Doctor, look! The lady at Medical gave me a plaster with pears on it! Rhodes Island has so many Infected. It's the same back home, but we didn't live so well. And I had nowhere to go... Doctor, Is it a bad thing to be an Infected?

title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
original: Deep in the pitch darkness, those warm breaths slowly got colder...' That's how Ray told her sandbeast stories. I've heard the workers saying stuff like that ever since the accident. They were kind of hard to understand at first, but I know what they mean now.

title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
original: Yeah, it hurts a lot when my Oripathy flares up. And I'm worried I could go out of control, too. Huff... Hufffff... Doctor, want to try a bite of stewed pear? It doesn't cure Oripathy, but it's sweet. When life's all hard and bitter, we need something sweet! Hehe, does it taste good? Alright, I'll take this to Lanns now.

title: Idle
original: Doctor? Are you feeling warmer? Have a good sleep now. I'm right here.

title: Onboard
original: Nice to see you again, Doctor. Do you miss Billy stew? I was just heading to the aft kitchen with Lanns— Hey! I'm not a little potlid. Don't call me Potlid!

title: Watching Battle Record
original: Whoa... Did you command all these battles, Doctor? You're amazing…

title: Promotion 1
original: I-I got promoted? Does that mean I can ask Closure to buy some more authentic ingredients?

title: Promotion 2
original: Thanks for your recognition, Doctor! I'll do what I can to bring even more warmth to the people! Um... Actually, what I mean is... I'm glad I can help out!

title: Added to Squad
original: I'm all set.

title: Appointed as Squad Leader
original: Huh? I'm the head chef today?

title: Depart
original: S-Slow down... Wait for me!

title: Begin Operation
original: They're not part of a good breakfast!

title: Selecting Operator 1
original: I'm here to help.

title: Selecting Operator 2
original: Fire up the barbie.

title: Deployment 1
original: Light and gentle…

title: Deployment 2
original: This place feels a little too cool…

title: In Battle 1
original: Sparky spark, hop n' jump!

title: In Battle 2
original: Little flames, shake n' dance!

title: In Battle 3
original: Roast their tummies!

title: In Battle 4
original: Shh, it's burning quietly.

title: 4-star Result
original: Everyone did such a great job... I'll make a big stew to reward them!

title: 3-star Result
original: Hm—Smells so good. Today was another huge success!

title: Sub 3-star Result
original: We spilled a lot out of the pot. What a shame...

title: Operation Failure
original: I wasn't paying attention, it's all burnt...

title: Assigned to Facility
original: This room's so warm… Hm? You can adjust the temperature with this panel?

title: Tap
original: Huff—huff—Didn't burn you, did I?

title: Trust Tap
original: I'm not— Okay, if it's what you want to call me, Doctor, then no worries. I am a little potlid.

title: Title
original: Arknights.

title: New Year's blessing
original: Happy New Year, Doctor! Do you want to go up to the deck to watch the fireworks together? Uh... It's not Arts. It's real fireworks. Everybody at Rhodes Island pitched in to make it happen! Shh—Do you hear that?

title: Greeting
original: Doctor, are you eating good today?

title: Birthday
original: Happy birthday, Doctor! Lanns and I made you a carrot cake! Oh… You've already got lots of cake from the others? Okay... Yes? You could eat a few slices and share the rest with Amiya and Savage? Haha, That's great! I'll light some candles!

title: Anniversary Celebration
original: When I was still small, I had so, so many wishes, but Dad only ever wished for me to grow up happily... Now I understand. I need to be happy first, then I'll wait for my other wishes to slowly come true. Doctor, make sure you'll be happy too, during this new year onboard Rhodes Island.
